title: no starvation — the live pass never queues behind history

setup.note: GATE-09's assertion re-homed onto the LIVE PASS (S4.4). 200 history day-bundles are queued in the log and the background lanes hold every slot they are allowed plus a full queue of waiters; then the same villa flush as LIV-01 runs the real tick. It must complete on the pool's reserved live lane — and it must do so while the lane is spending TWO calls per bundle, which is what Build §7.3's fallback costs. The parked history work is never released until after the live path is done, so a live call that waited on it could not finish at all.

expected.note: The assertion is the LANE, not the arithmetic: one understanding call and one critic, both on the reserved live lane, neither waiting on the parked history work. The decide count is deliberately NOT pinned — it follows `DEFAULT_LIVE_MODE`, which is "merged" since R1 (understanding and decide in one answer, zero extra calls) and would be 1 under Build §7.3's two-call fallback. The executor derives it, so selecting the fallback does not turn this case red.
